messages:
deploybot: [BUILD] Pipeline started for tag v2.14.0 on staging — commit a3f4b9d. Components: api, runtime. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/8921

deploybot: [FAIL] Stage: smoke-tests failed. Job: smoke-suite. Failing test: runtime/tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_eviction. Exit code 1. Excerpt:
```
E   RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating tensor (tried to allocate 256.00 MiB)
----------------------------- Captured stdout call -----------------------------
[INFO] starting smoke run on gpu0
```

kevin: saw the alert, pulling logs now. any recent infra changes? :thinking_face:

ci-bot: Flakiness summary for test_prefix_eviction: last 7 runs => [pass, fail, pass, fail, fail, pass, fail]. Marked flaky? yes (2+ failures in last 7).

mina: Heads-up: still inside change window until 18:00 PT. If this is an infra regression we should pin or rollback quickly. What's the customer impact if we continue canary?

devon: looks deterministic on the CUDA path — local reproduce attempts hit OOM consistently. If canary continues, risk of increased error rate for embeddings on staging mirrors. Recommend pin runtime lib or halt rollout.

kevin: reproducing locally now: `pytest tests/runtime/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_eviction -k smoke -q` -> fails immediately with same OOM. Not flaky here.

qa-igor: OOM suggests tensor shapes changed or quantization causing memory spike. Recent PRs: runtime/quantize change landed in last merge (runtime v0.10.0). Pinning to runtime v0.9.3 has been stable in last 10 builds.

mina: decision proposal: pin runtime to v0.9.3 for staging deploy (override), abort canary for v2.14.0. If re-run still fails, escalate to rollback the tag and cut a hotfix branch. Approve? :white_check_mark:

kevin: +1 to pin and re-run. I'll open a quick PR with the override in deploy config and trigger a rebuild.

devon: +1. I'll put holds in the routing policy so no auto-promotion to prod until signoff.

deploybot: Action: pin runtime->v0.9.3 applied in overrides.yaml (PR #1042). Re-run queued: build 8922. Re-run started at 12:45:26 UTC.

mina: filing a short release note: "Canary for v2.14.0 paused due to runtime memory regression; staging pinned to runtime v0.9.3 pending investigation." Will add to release board.

ci-bot: build 8922 queued -> running. Will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: pinging infra to freeze auto-rollouts until QA signoff. @sre-oncall please hold. :eyes:

kevin: tracking the reproducer and creating a minimal reproducer snippet, posting to PR comments.

mina: thanks — keep updates short here. If 8922 passes, we'll re-evaluate canary strategy (maybe A/B with runtime pin). If 8922 fails, cut hotfix 2.14.1 and rollback v2.14.0 from staging/canary.
